timeline.summary: Gaurav Goel, on behalf of promoters and promoter group, declared no encumbrance of Dhampur Sugar Mills’ equity shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on 01.04.2026.
Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited’s Board of Directors, chaired by **Aparna Goel**, declared an interim dividend of ₹2 per equity share (20% of ₹10 face value) on May 20, 2026, payable by June 15, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹687.35 Cr (-15.2% YoY), net profit ₹45.7 Cr (-6.8% YoY).
Dhampur Sugar Mills reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹687.35 Cr and net profit of ₹45.64 Cr, and executed an SPA to acquire a 51% stake in Venus India Asset-Finance.
